distinctness_from_form_a: D1 uses withdrawal and money-weighted versus horizon-correct linked returns, sample rather than population covariance, and capped GMV with shrinkage. A uses a contribution/ending fee and mean-variance utility with mean uncertainty.
D2 uses two securities in three states, a continuum of positive pricing extensions and a superhedge arbitrage; A uses complete-market replication and risk-tolerance aggregation.

D3 uses omitted-factor projection, net matched benchmark, vintage contamination, actual collateral costs, survivorship and reuse of a holdout. A uses exact factor/residual SDF pricing and selecting a sign rule or its negative.

D4 uses a gated nontradable payoff, transaction-cost displacement, a binding cash deadline and futures variation sharing the private-call reserve. A uses a liability hedge, conditional versus terminal variance and a private distribution following a gross call.
D5 uses passive BUY selection and a newly prospective IPS with no joint integer repair without external funding or cap waiver. A uses a signed SELL target and a feasible temporary integer repair.

scoring_review.error_carry_forward: No repeated arithmetic penalty for coherent later methods; grant independently corrected reasoning. Do not certify an impossible pricing/funding or contaminated evidence claim merely because a mistaken prior premise was carried forward.
scoring_review.fairness: All required methods appear in accepted prerequisites. Full contract rights, fee bases, dates, information states and units supplied. Each domain permits about 48 minutes; no simulation, optimization software, empirical download, numerical root search or graduate-only tool is required.
critical_errors: treating a negative gross IRR root as an investment return
using physical expectation as unique incomplete-market price without pricing assumptions
certifying an unfunded or state-negative trade as arbitrage
validating future-information or post-selection performance as untouched evidence
spending gated NAV or the same margin cash twice
declaring cash-only repair compliant while ignoring active-risk cap
treating sponsor cash as investment gain or rewriting a historical benchmark

validation.result: Passed 8 groups / 356 comparisons, including structural, rubric and source comparisons; 7 economic-domain rejection cases. These are not 356 distinct financial derivations.
